candidate.description: Use only the exact supported fields for target_kind documented below. Omit unknown values. Do not use action, deadline, date, time or scheduled_at as candidate keys; those names do not populate product fields. Existing receipts retain their original validation contract.

actionability.description: Assess this action, not the message category. Confirmed future attendance remains an open required appointment after its payment is complete. An optional choice remains conditional.

condition.description: Actual prerequisite for whether this action applies; null when not applicable. Before-arrival timing is a deadline; to restore service describes a desired outcome, not a prerequisite.

condition_state.description: met: source proves the prerequisite holds now; unmet: source explicitly proves it false; unknown: not established or not yet chosen; not_applicable: there is no prerequisite. Never infer acceptance or ownership.

date_role.description: deadline is when an action must be done, including preparation before a confirmed visit; occurrence is the time of a confirmed event; reporting frequency is not recurrence.

role.description: Apply only to this candidate action and object. negation cancels or removes this same action; completion affirms this same action was performed. Unrelated unaffected accounts, not-yet-completed work and undecided attendance are neither completion nor cancellation of another action. condition cites a genuine prerequisite, not a desired result. Paid purchase or completed registration does not mean future attendance was completed: never use its payment or registration clause as completion evidence on a calendar attendance candidate.

qualifying_evidence.description: List only clauses that qualify this candidate action and object, not every status clause in the message. completion or negation asserts this candidate has no remaining action. For future attendance, exclude completed payment, purchase or registration from these roles; cite the confirmed booking as ownership and its occurrence time as date. A paid future booking remains open attendance with no payment task. Omit unrelated terminal clauses rather than labeling them completion.

blocking_question_indices.description: Zero-based indexes into this candidate's unresolved_questions that prevent establishing whether the obligation is currently required. Include amount/balance or already-paid/scheduled uncertainty when payment itself is not established. Use [] when there are no unanswered questions or the remaining questions concern only execution details of an established obligation, such as payment method. Do not borrow questions from another action. Omission remains accepted for historical receipts but does not establish nonblocking uncertainty during new processing.

candidate.description: For task, emit only these keys: description, due, energy, effort_min. Values must be supported by this candidate's own evidence.

description.description: Text describing this one grounded action; do not split a preparatory verb into a duplicate outcome.

due.description: Supported ISO 8601 action deadline, with an exact date citation. Preserve stated time and offset; omit rather than invent them. Not a prerequisite or an event start.

energy.description: Source-supported energy label: low, medium or high; omit when unstated.

effort_min.description: Nonnegative integer effort in minutes only when supported.

candidate.description: For commitment, emit only these keys: kind, owed_to_party_id, due, urgency, source_interaction_id, source_message_preview. Values must be supported by this candidate's own evidence.

kind.description: Source-supported kind for commitment; omit when unknown. Never invent or resolve an internal identity.

owed_to_party_id.description: Source-supported owed_to_party_id for commitment; omit when unknown. Never invent or resolve an internal identity.

urgency.description: Supported commitment urgency: today, this_week, this_month or no_rush.

source_interaction_id.description: Source-supported source_interaction_id for commitment; omit when unknown. Never invent or resolve an internal identity.

source_message_preview.description: Verbatim short excerpt supporting this commitment.

candidate.description: For calendar_event, emit only these keys: start, end, all_day, event_type, location. Values must be supported by this candidate's own evidence.

start.description: Supported ISO 8601 start of a confirmed event; cite its occurrence date. A deadline or tentative invitation alone is not an event.

end.description: Supported ISO 8601 end only if evidenced; never invent duration.

all_day.description: Boolean true only when the event is explicitly all-day or date-only.

location.description: Location explicitly supported for this event.
